# EZZ BILL

> EZZ BILL keeps every bill in one place. Scan a receipt, upload a PDF, paste a payment text or tap an NFC tag at a restaurant table; EZZ BILL reads the shop, date, items, tax and total, and shows where the money went.

Built for India: rupees first, GST bills, UPI payments. What is printed on a bill is shown as fact; anything the app estimates is labelled.

## Pages

- [Sign in](/login): Sign in to your EZZ BILL account.
- [Sign up](/signup): Create an EZZ BILL account.
- [Reset your password](/forgot-password): Get a link to set a new password.
- [Terms and Conditions](/terms): The terms for using EZZ BILL.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How EZZ BILL handles your data, including Gmail access.

## Optional

- [Home](/): This month's spending and recent bills (requires sign in).
- [Bills](/expenses): Every bill, searchable by shop and item (requires sign in).
- [Spending](/analytics): Spending by category and shop (requires sign in).
- [Money Leaks](/money-leaks): Spending against a personal ideal budget (requires sign in).
- [Subscriptions](/subscriptions): Recurring charges and the next renewal (requires sign in).
- [Warranty vault](/warranties): Warranties and when cover ends (requires sign in).
